versions.name: Ma-Ka-Ja-Wan Scout Reservation - East
versions.address: W6500 Spring Lake Rd Pearson, Wisconsin 54462

features.note: A 42-foot tower with multiple climbing faces and an interior chimney.
Trailblazer, a half-day introduction for first-time campers.
Fishing from docks, a pontoon, or open boating time.
Wood carving, leatherwork, basketry, pottery, and sculpture.
Flow trails and singletrack ridden on mountain and fat-tire bikes.
A dedicated face of the climbing tower is used for rappelling.
Spring-fed lake frontage with docks and a swim area.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Website repaired 2026-07-25: the stored link was a registration portal (https://scoutingevent.com/129-2026MSREastCamp); replaced with the council's own camp page, found by tools/find_camp_pages.py and confirmed to name the camp. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
